source.title: OpenAI shares new prompting tips for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to fix brief answers and unnecessary questions
source.text: OpenAI has released new prompt templates for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol meant to fix common model behaviors such as overly brief answers, unnecessary follow-up questions, and excessive testing when coding. The API is changing as well, since editing a conversation's history can discard reasoning content and lower response quality. The article OpenAI shares new prompting tips for GPT-6.2 Astra and Sol to fix brief answers and unnecessary questions appeared first on The Decoder .
